title: Pure T.G.
summary: T.G. cards only, with generic staples. Most T.G. monsters search another T.G. when they are destroyed on the field, so the deck turns its own losses into resources and climbs into T.G. Synchros. The 2023 cards lead. T.G. All Clear makes every T.G. a Machine, grants an extra T.G. Normal Summon, and destroys a T.G. to search another. T.G. Limiter Removal searches two T.G. monsters. T.G. Rocket Salamander tributes a T.G. for a different one from the Deck. T.G. Close negates any activation while you control a Machine T.G. T.G. Mighty Striker Synchro Summons on the opponent's turn and searches a T.G. Spell/Trap. T.G. Glaive Blaster banishes Extra Deck monsters once per non-Tuner Synchro used. T.G. Hyper Librarian is Limited. T.G. Halberd Cannon/Assault Mode needs Assault Mode Activate and stays out.

exclude.T.G. Halberd Cannon/Assault Mode: Needs Assault Mode Activate, which the pure list doesn't play.
